messages:
From: David Ross <david.ross@clemencehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Upfront billing offset & packaging carveout for VPC pilot

Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Clemence is keen to move forward with a small VPC pilot (6 months) but finance has flagged the upfront network provisioning + private capacity onboarding fees. They asked if Redwood can offset some of those costs against an upfront committed usage guarantee, and they also requested a temporary packaging carveout that includes a lower seat minimum for the pilot.

Short ask: can you confirm whether a one-off upfront billing offset (applied as a credit against first-quarter invoices) plus a 6-month reduced seat minimum is something Redwood can approve? If not, what approvals would be required and a rough timeline?

Attached: SOW draft and our internal pricing worksheet so you can see the numbers.

David Ross
Clemence Health — Head of Ops
Attachment: Clemence_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Clemence_pricing_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Request: Upfront billing offset & packaging carveout for VPC pilot

Looping you both in — Clemence is asking for a one-time offset to cover onboarding/network provisioning (~$45k) and wants to lower the pilot seat minimum from 10 to 3 for six months. Prospect is strategic in Midwest health vertical; they'd like to launch before end of Q3.

My read: this is a finance-facing exception (small ARR but strategic case), and we should evaluate with a protected downside (credit clawback if they don't hit commit). Jordan, can you confirm commercial workaround (billing credit structure + fallback)? Marissa, can you draft a short exception memo for VP/CFO signoff if we recommend approval?

Quick notes: 1) We can push telemetry/usage reporting into the SOW. 2) Recommend credit amortized over first invoice(s) but visible as line-item.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: David Ross <david.ross@clemencehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Upfront billing offset & packaging carveout for VPC pilot

Thanks for the context, Kim. I reviewed the attachments and ran the numbers. Summary and recommendation below — I can convert this into a two-page exception memo for VP/CFO (Markus) if you agree.

Summary:
- One-time onboarding/network provisioning estimate: ~$45,000 (customer-supplied SOW).
- Requested packaging carveout: reduce minimum seats from 10 -> 3 for 6 months.
- Expected ARR from pilot (conservative): ~$70k over 6 months; expected 12-month revenue if converted: ~$300k.

Risk controls / proposed commercial guardrails:
- Offer a $40k upfront credit applied to the first invoice, amortized clearly as a line item (not prepaid).
- Credit clawback: if Clemence terminates before 6 months or fails to meet a minimum usage threshold (40% of expected), remaining prorated credit becomes due on termination.
- Temporary packaging carveout expires after 6 months; standard seat minimums revert automatically unless renew agreement approved by Ops/Finance.
- Require telemetry/weekly usage reports and an executive check-in at month 3.

Recommendation: Approve with guardrails above. This is a strategic reference account in a target vertical; upside if we convert to a full deployment. Request: VP/CFO signoff (Markus) for an exception to standard packaging and to authorize the $40k one-time credit.

If you want, I'll format this as a formal exception memo (covering business case, financials, legal easements) and route to Markus for signature.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_exception_memo_draft.docx (will attach on final memo)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Markus —

Please see draft recommendation from Marissa below. My position: approve the $40k credit with the clawback and the 6-month seat carveout. Clemence has clear conversion potential and the guardrails protect downside. If you approve, Marissa will convert to a final exception memo and I'll coordinate accounting to reflect the credit treatment.

Request: Can you sign off (VP/CFO) on the exception and credit authorization by EOD Wednesday 19 Aug so we can send an updated SOW and finalize the pilot start date?

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
